grammar.title: Not only... but also with 不仅...还/也
grammar.pattern: 不仅 + A，(主语) + 还/也 + B
grammar.explanation: 不仅 (bùjǐn) means "not only" — like 不但, it's followed by 还 or 也 to add a second, often stronger point. 不仅 is a little more formal and common in writing.

grammar.title: A casual if with 要是...就
grammar.pattern: 要是 + 条件，(主语) + 就 + 结果
grammar.explanation: 要是 (yàoshi) is a colloquial way of saying "if", used mostly in spoken Chinese instead of 如果. The result clause still uses 就 to mean "then", just like with 如果...就.

sentences.zh: 他不仅会说汉语，还会说英语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn huì shuō Hànyǔ, hái huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
sentences.en: He can not only speak Chinese, but also English.

sentences.zh: 这个电影不仅精彩，也很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng bùjǐn jīngcǎi, yě hěn yǒuyìsi.
sentences.en: This movie is not only exciting, but also interesting.

sentences.zh: 这个地方不仅安静，还很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang bùjǐn ānjìng, hái hěn piàoliang.
sentences.en: This place is not only quiet, but also pretty.
